summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release about entering a Support and Benefits Agreement with the District of Wells, British Columbia, for the Cariboo Gold Project. The agreement provides for up to C$3.0 million in voluntary financial contributions over three years for community infrastructure. No specific terms, premium, advisor, or board recommendation were noted. This is a community relations agreement, not a special-situation corporate event. This non-US filing is equivalent to a routine current report on Form 6-K; no US-equivalent special situation applies. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
